name: smwsprites-giant-reflecting-fireball
title: Giant Reflecting Fireball
description:
This is a 32x32 version of the reflecting fireball sprite that bounces around diagonally.

Arinsu: Recoded everything from scratch; inspired on ASM's work, but code is mine. Now includes a variety of options including flipping graphics when hitting a wall, follow Mario or disable palette flashing. Also added SA-1 and PIXI compatibility.
